name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: A multi-step progress indicator: circles fill, check marks draw and connectors fill as the position advances.
useWhen: Showing a multi-step onboarding, checkout or wizard flow advancing through numbered steps.
Demonstrating step completion with check marks, circle fills and connector fills.
Visualizing progress through a sequential workflow with labelled stages.
avoidWhen: Steps have no sequential order: use tabs.
You need a continuous fill bar without numbered steps: use progress.
You need a compact segmented control that switches view modes: use toggle-group.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
